Електроразпределение Юг ЕАД има закупена и внедрена GPS-система (система за глобално позициониране) както и съпътстващ програмен продукт SmartTracker за управление на автопарка, представляващ компютърна програма по смисъла на закона за авторското право и сродните му права (ЗАПСП). Системата е собственост на ВЕМ ТЕХНОЛОДЖИ ЕООД, гр. София, р-н Северен, ул."Васил Левски" № 150. Във връзка с потребностите на Възложителя е необходимо извършване на надграждане на съществуващата в Електроразпределение Юг ЕАД, система за GPS проследяване и разработка на софтуер за дигитализация на автомобилните инспекции и предоставянето на нейната извънгаранционна поддръжка. Възложителят изпрати имейл от 21.05.2025 до собственика на GPS-системата и приложението SmartTracker, в което моли да му бъдат предоставени: документ, удостоверяващ собствеността върху програмния продукт SmartTracker, както и документ, от който да е видно, че ВЕМ ТЕХНОЛОДЖИ ЕООД не е оторизирал други лица за разпространение и поддръжка на програмния продукт на територията на Република България. В отговор на запитването е получено писмо, с което ВЕМ ТЕХНОЛОДЖИ ЕООД декларира, че е единствен собственик на SmartTracker и притежава всички права на интелектуална собственост над продукта. ВЕМ ТЕХНОЛОДЖИ ЕООД гарантира, че има право да извършва продажба на GPS-системата и приложението SmartTracker, както и да извършва неговата поддръжка и доработки. От посочения като доказателство документ е видно, че за територията на Република България единствено производителят на системата има изключителни права за разработка на нови функционалности и поддръжка. Предвид наличието на изключителни права по чл. 18 от Закона за авторското право и сродните му права (ЗАПСП), ВЕМ ТЕХНОЛОДЖИ ЕООД е единственото лице, с което може да бъде сключен договор за разработване на софтуер за дигитализация на автомобилните инспекции и предоставянето на нейната извънгаранционна поддръжка. title: LIGHT CONDUCTION AND DIFFUSION MATERIALS FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF LIGHT INTENSIFIED PHOTOBIOREACTORS
description: ObjectivesTo increase the efficiency of photobioreactors by an improved design of light conduction anddiffusion inside the reactor.DescriptionThe need for regenerative life support systems for long term space missions necessitates a questfor increased efficiency of Photobioreactors. The light intensification of photobioreactors is animportant building block to increase the return on investment with respect to light energy introducedvs oxygen yield in a defined volume.Previous activities have identified as a priority the need to progress on specific technologies, suchas the type of light sources and on innovative materials for light conductionand diffusion (e.g.polymers, leaking rods, specific optical fibers, lightning fabrics). This activity attempts to push theboundaries of photobioractor efficiency even further (compared to BIORAT-1) by investigating amore efficient light diffusion and as well characterization of the impact on the process and thebiomass.This activity encompasses the following tasks:- Review the state of the art for light intensified photobioreactiors and energy efficient lightguidance systems- Design a test bench with realistic operational parameters (light, flow, active species etc.)and test the most optimal configuration to achieve best possible efficiency w.r.t. volumetricoxygen and biomass production- Assess the potential biological effects of immersed light sources and possiblecountermeasures against fouling and clogging- Provide a development plan for operational hardware on ground and in space includingMAIT aspects for an operational scenario and define the scaling laws.

title: 54 MBAUD SOFTWARE DEFINED DEMODULATOR ON LOW-END PROCESSOR OR GRAPHICS PROCESSING UNIT (ARTES AT 7B.090) - RE-ISSUE
description: Objective: The objective of the activity is to design, develop and test a 54 Mbaud DVB-S2 and 5G NR demodulator on a low-end Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) or Central Processing Unit (CPU).Targeted Improvements: Enabling a 54 Mbaud software defined radio for low end platforms not existing today in ESA Member States.Description: Previous projects have demonstrated that carriers of equivalent bandwidth can be demodulated in software on x86 server-level CPUs. Also, by using high-performance GPUs and parallel processing, bandwidths of hundreds of MHz or even many GHz could be demodulated. To date, a low-cost GPU or CPU-based demodulation solution with typical consumer terminal performance have not been developed. Such technology would allow field-upgradable terminals that can enable the deployment of new waveforms without expensive hardware swaps in the middle of the life of the system.This activity will develop and test a software-based demodulator running in a consumer GPU as found in a games console or a PC graphics card or a low-end CPU (Intel Core i3 or equivalent), with a throughput equivalent to a TV receiver or a consumer satellite broadband terminal. Superior demodulation algorithms than those in common open-source Software Defined Radio (SDR) toolkits will be studied and further developed and implemented.The activity will be implemented in a phased approach:- Phase 1 shall implement and test a DVB-S2/S2X demodulator on one of the hardware platforms described above. The DVB-S2/X demodulator software will be tested against a hardware modulator or dedicated test equipment in the relevant environment to ensure the baud rate is met and fully compliant with as a minimum theDVB-S2 specification. Phase 1 deliverable will be a DVB-S2/S2X demodulator on a low-end CPU or GPU platform. Budget is up to 700 kEuro.- Phase 2 shall implement and test in the relevant environment 5G-NR waveform or other proprietary waveform development on the hardware platform delivered by Phase 1.Procurement Policy: C(1) = Activity restricted to non-prime contractors (incl. SMEs). description: Gegenstand des Gesamtauftrags ist die losweise Beschaffung und Einführung eines neuen a) Enterprise Resource Planning-Systems (Los 1: ERP-System) und b) Human Capital Management-Systems (Los 2: HCM-System) Die beiden Systeme sollen gemeinsam die verschiedenen Prozesse der beiden Gesellschaften unterstützen, unter anderem Finanzbuchhaltung und Controlling inkl. Neben den beiden Systemen ist angedacht, ein Dokumentenmanagementsystem (DMS-System) zur Unterstützung von dokumentenbasierten Workflows (z. B. Freigaben, Rechnungsprüfung) auszuwählen und einzuführen. Derzeit wird bereits ein SAP ERP-System mit einem integrierten Human Resource-Modul (HR-Modul) eingesetzt, das im Rahmen des angebotenen Umfangs migriert werden soll. Das ERP-System muss zudem Schnittstellen zu verschiedenen bestehenden Satellitensystemen aufbauen. Der Vertrag wird auf unbestimmte Zeit geschlossen. Es erfolgt eine Aufteilung der Leistungen in 2 Lose. - Das Los 1 umfasst die Bereitstellung und Betrieb eines ERP-Systems einschließlich Dokumentenmanagement-System (DMS), falls erforderlich Data-Warehouse- und Business-Intelligence-Komponenten, sowie die Projektleistung zur Einführung der Lösungen. Darüber hinaus sind auch der Betrieb und die Anwendungsbetreuung der Systeme nach der erfolgreichen Implementierung Bestandteil dieses Loses. - Das Los 2 umfasst die Bereitstellung und Betrieb eines Human-Capital-Management-Systems (HCM) zur Abbildung der personalwirtschaftlichen Prozesse sowie die Projektleistung zur Einführung der Lösung. Darüber hinaus sind auch der Betrieb und die Anwendungsbetreuung des Systems nach der erfolgreichen Implementierung Bestandteil dieses Loses. Die vorliegende Ausschreibung umfasst nur das oben beschriebene Los 1 (ERP-System). Eine Bewerbung auch für das Los 2 (HCM-System) ist nur über den gesonderten Projektraum für das Los 2 möglich.
